chapter: Opinions on pop music, jazz education and the business
title: Scott Hamilton as proof that young jazz players get a chance
summary: Wilson praises Scott Hamilton for playing inside the 32-bar structure rather than imitating Coltrane, and Hinton notes he gave him his first job.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
